name: Grove of Myths - Heroes of the Storm
source:
Streamer Anel vanishes without a trace during a livestream from a forest grove, and her friend Arai, together with the skeptical Daniil, sets out to find her.
But beneath the shadows of the ancient trees, logic holds no power. To save their friend, they will have to play by the forest’s rules — or remain there forever…
